# ViewFingerprint

`schemas/records/view-fingerprint.json`

What a derived view was rendered from (docs/design/m0/10). digest is "sha256:" followed by the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 (JCS) encoding of {"renderer": renderer, "inputs": [the identity_digest of each input, in order]}: the inputs' identities, not their content digests. A view is served only if its recomputed fingerprint matches. A fingerprint proves the view matches its inputs, nothing more: evidence applicability is checked separately (06).
